answer.justification: The patient meets the DSM-5 criteria for Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD). He has experienced excessive worry regarding multiple domains (health and finances) for at least 6 months. His symptoms include insomnia, irritability, muscle tension (being tense), and difficulty concentrating (inattentiveness), which are key diagnostic criteria for GAD when occurring more days than not.
